事务、版本、请求指纹、旧表单及跨队归属保护

maintenance.scope: Actual admin/H5 Vue, HTTPS authorization and production handlers with isolated transactional records. No customer deployment, customer writes or physical device verification.

approved public team profile displays the same badge without exposing storage references or contact data

interrupted replacement preserves the old badge and retries only work not already acknowledged by the server

restore-default cancellation retains the badge; confirmed removal and a later fresh upload both work
